title: Economics Faculty
description:
University of Rochester. Economics Faculty. Teach economics courses
at the university level. Develop the course curriculum, advise
students, and supervise student projects. Participate in
professional activities such as research and publishing.
Participate in service activities such as attending departmental
and college faculty meetings. PhD in Economics or closely related
field. $168,000 to $180,000 per annum. CV to Arianna Bennigsohn,
Business Administrator, arianna.bennigsohn@rochester.edu
